## Checklist

- [ ] **Build**: typecheck, lint and build pass (CI)
- [ ] **Review**: code reviewed
- [ ] **Test**: `yarn test:api` passes locally against this branch's backend; acceptance criteria tried on the preview
- [ ] **Accept**: behaves as expected
- [ ] **Ship**: merged, deployed, migration applied, production smoke-tested
- [ ] New migration? Reviewed the SQL, and it's safe to apply to production on merge
